"""WritebackProposal schema contracts (Phase 18 wave-1; canonical)."""

from __future__ import annotations

import ast
import json
from pathlib import Path

import pytest

from llamaindex_runtime.okf.writeback.proposal import (
    TARGET_ROOTS,
    WritebackProposal,
    read_proposal,
    write_proposal,
)

GOLDEN_PROPOSAL_ID = "32e71258-0224-5d5e-8626-98d3e1b62578"


def _proposal(**overrides):
    kwargs = dict(
        target_file="entities/org/huawei.md",
        patch="REPLACE-BODY",
        reason="evidence-backed add",
        evidence=("span-1", "span-2"),
        proposed_by="agent-1",
        created_at="2026-09-03T00:00:00Z",
    )
    kwargs.update(overrides)
    return WritebackProposal(**kwargs)


def test_construction_pins_derived_fields() -> None:
    p = _proposal()
    assert p.status == "created"
    assert p.unverified is False
    assert p.proposal_id == GOLDEN_PROPOSAL_ID


def test_unverified_when_no_evidence() -> None:
    assert _proposal(evidence=()).unverified is True


def test_proposal_id_deterministic() -> None:
    a = _proposal()
    b = _proposal()
    assert a.proposal_id == b.proposal_id == GOLDEN_PROPOSAL_ID


def test_raw_target_rejected() -> None:
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        _proposal(target_file="raw/source.md")


def test_outside_writable_zones_rejected() -> None:
    for bad in ("templates/page.md", "index.md", "log.md", "other/x.md"):
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            _proposal(target_file=bad)


def test_absolute_and_traversal_targets_rejected() -> None:
    for bad in ("/abs.md", "C:/abs.md", "entities/../raw/x.md", "./entities/x.md"):
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            _proposal(target_file=bad)


def test_blank_or_bytes_target_rejected() -> None:
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        _proposal(target_file="   ")
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        _proposal(target_file=b"entities/x.md")


def test_empty_patch_rejected() -> None:
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        _proposal(patch="")
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        _proposal(patch="   ")


def test_blank_reason_rejected() -> None:
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        _proposal(reason="")


def test_blank_proposed_by_rejected() -> None:
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        _proposal(proposed_by="")


def test_bad_created_at_rejected() -> None:
    for bad in ("2026-09-03", "2026-09-03 00:00:00", "", b"2026-09-03T00:00:00Z"):
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            _proposal(created_at=bad)


def test_evidence_str_rejected_list_converted() -> None:
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        _proposal(evidence="span-1")
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        _proposal(evidence=("span-1", 42))
    p = _proposal(evidence=["span-1"])
    assert p.evidence == ("span-1",)


def test_status_is_not_creatable() -> None:
    with pytest.raises(TypeError):
        WritebackProposal(
            target_file="entities/x.md",
            patch="p",
            reason="r",
            evidence=(),
            proposed_by="a",
            created_at="2026-09-03T00:00:00Z",
            status="approved",
        )


def test_frozen() -> None:
    p = _proposal()
    with pytest.raises(Exception):
        p.patch = "mutated"  # type: ignore[misc]


def test_to_dict_keys_exact() -> None:
    p = _proposal()
    data = p.to_dict()
    assert set(data) == {
        "target_file",
        "patch",
        "reason",
        "evidence",
        "proposed_by",
        "created_at",
        "status",
        "unverified",
        "proposal_id",
    }


def test_round_trip() -> None:
    p = _proposal()
    assert WritebackProposal.from_dict(p.to_dict()) == p


def test_from_dict_non_mapping_rejected() -> None:
    for bad in ("nope", 42, ["x"], None):
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            WritebackProposal.from_dict(bad)


def test_from_dict_missing_key_rejected() -> None:
    data = _proposal().to_dict()
    del data["target_file"]
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        WritebackProposal.from_dict(data)


def test_from_dict_unknown_key_rejected() -> None:
    data = _proposal().to_dict()
    data["bogus"] = 1
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        WritebackProposal.from_dict(data)


def test_from_dict_bad_evidence_rejected() -> None:
    data = _proposal().to_dict()
    data["evidence"] = "span-1"
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        WritebackProposal.from_dict(data)


def test_write_proposal_lands_json(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    staging = tmp_path / ".staging"
    p = _proposal()
    out = write_proposal(staging, p)
    assert out == staging / (p.proposal_id + ".json")
    data = json.loads(out.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    assert WritebackProposal.from_dict(data) == p


def test_write_proposal_duplicate_rejected(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    staging = tmp_path / ".staging"
    p = _proposal()
    write_proposal(staging, p)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        write_proposal(staging, p)


def test_write_proposal_creates_nested_dir(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    staging = tmp_path / "bundle" / ".staging"
    out = write_proposal(staging, _proposal())
    assert out.exists()


def test_read_proposal_missing_file(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    with pytest.raises(FileNotFoundError):
        read_proposal(tmp_path / "nope.json")


def test_read_proposal_invalid_json(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    bad = tmp_path / "bad.json"
    bad.write_text("{not json", encoding="utf-8")
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        read_proposal(bad)


def test_ast_purity_allowlist() -> None:
    import llamaindex_runtime.okf.writeback.proposal as mod

    source = Path(mod.__file__).read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    tree = ast.parse(source)
    allowed = {
        "__future__",
        "collections.abc",
        "dataclasses",
        "datetime",
        "json",
        "os",
        "pathlib",
        "typing",
        "uuid",
    }
    for node in ast.walk(tree):
        if isinstance(node, ast.Import):
            for alias in node.names:
                root = alias.name.split(".")[0]
                assert root in allowed, alias.name
        elif isinstance(node, ast.ImportFrom):
            root = (node.module or "").split(".")[0]
            assert root in allowed, node.module
tests.llamaindex_runtime/okf/test_parser_stagi:
"""Parser .staging exclusion contracts (Phase 18 wave-1; canonical)."""

from __future__ import annotations

from pathlib import Path

import pytest

from llamaindex_runtime.okf.parser import OKFParser


def _write_non_raw(root: Path, relative: str, content: str | None = None) -> None:
    target = root / relative
    target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    body = content if content is not None else "---\ntype: legacy_entity\n---\nbody\n"
    target.write_text(body, encoding="utf-8")


def _bundle(root: Path) -> None:
    _write_non_raw(root, "index.md", "# index\n")
    _write_non_raw(root, "log.md", "# log\n")
    _write_non_raw(root, "entities/keep.md")


def test_staging_markdown_never_ingested(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    root = tmp_path / "bundle"
    _bundle(root)
    _write_non_raw(root, ".staging/draft.md")
    _write_non_raw(root, ".staging/sub/nested.md")
    parser = OKFParser()
    result = parser.parse_bundle(root)
    assert len(result.documents) == 1
    stats = parser.last_bundle_stats
    assert stats.parsed == 1
    assert stats.skipped == 4
    assert stats.malformed == 0


def test_deep_staging_excluded(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    root = tmp_path / "bundle"
    _bundle(root)
    _write_non_raw(root, ".staging/candidates/sub/deep.md")
    parser = OKFParser()
    result = parser.parse_bundle(root)
    assert len(result.documents) == 1
    assert parser.last_bundle_stats.skipped == 3


def test_staging_json_is_never_a_candidate(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    root = tmp_path / "bundle"
    _bundle(root)
    _write_non_raw(root, ".staging/32e71258-0224-5d5e-8626-98d3e1b62578.json", "{}\n")
    parser = OKFParser()
    result = parser.parse_bundle(root)
    assert len(result.documents) == 1
    assert parser.last_bundle_stats.skipped == 2


def test_existing_skip_behavior_preserved(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    root = tmp_path / "bundle"
    _bundle(root)
    parser = OKFParser()
    result = parser.parse_bundle(root)
    assert len(result.documents) == 1
    assert parser.last_bundle_stats.parsed == 1
    assert parser.last_bundle_stats.skipped == 2
